The '''Void Sepulture''' is a sub-location of [[The End]]. 

{{ZoneText|Defeat fanatics for &5Enderman Slayer&f.|Be careful.}}

== Features ==
The '''Void Sepulture''' features a few attractions.

=== Teleport Pad ===
Located at {{Coordinates|-562|7|-314}} is a teleport pad granting access to the '''Void Sepulture'''. The player must have at least {{skl|combat|XXV}} in order to use the teleport pad to enter the '''Void Sepulture'''.
Above the teleport pad is a hologram reading {{Rmt|&c&lDANGEROUS!}}.

== Trivia ==
*Players that somehow manage to enter the '''Void Sepulture''' without meeting the [[Combat]] requirement will be teleported out.
*Sepulture is an archaic word for a burial.
